Florida Gators at Georgia Bulldogs

highlights.headline: Highlight: Georgia books SEC Championship ticket in comeback over Florida
highlights.description: The 1-seed Bulldogs dig out of an early 6-0 deficit behind RBIs from six different batters to battle back and stun the 5-seed Gators, 8-7.

events.name: Arkansas Razorbacks at Auburn Tigers

highlights.headline: Highlight: 7-seed Arkansas holds off 6-seed Auburn, cements SEC Championship bid
highlights.description: Cam Kozeal brings in an RBI and Ryder Helfrick hits the lone home run for the Razorbacks as they erase the Tigers' early 1-0 lead to collect the 2-1 win in the semis.
